The '''Banthal Company Docks''' were an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] docking array located in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]]. They were targeted annually by the [[Norulac Freebooters]] when they raided the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
